name: Open5e and the 5e SRD API
author: Wizard
summary: Pull free rules books (Tome of Beasts, Deep Magic, Vault of Magic, the SRD 5.2 and 5.1 ...) from Open5e and the 5e SRD API into this world: monsters, spells, items and more.

rules.text: This world can pull free books from Open5e and the 5e SRD API in World settings → Game module, and the GM's assistant can import them.

assistant.gm: To add a book: list_content_books gives the keys, import_content pulls it (the GM approves). Books the server admin already keeps are under Available in World settings → Game module and need no download.
